scope: Additive X-Bow normal/air-and-ground targeting baseline and current TH18 Supercharge correction.
game_version: Official August 2021, June 2023, April and June 2026 Home Village notes, with current secondary tables consulted on 2026-09-19.

sources.title: Balance Changes
sources.limitations: Confirms that Home Village Air & Ground mode is 11.5 tiles, after an increase from 11.0. It does not define ground-mode targeting/range, ammunition lifecycle, projectile behavior or deterministic order.

sources.title: June Balance Changes!
sources.limitations: Confirms post-balance damage values for levels 4-9. It is not a complete current table or an attack/ammunition lifecycle contract.

sources.title: THE SOUND OF CLASH UPDATE
sources.limitations: Confirms TH18 X-Bow level 13, but has no complete stat or targeting table.

sources.title: THE ANIME FURY UPDATE IS HERE
sources.limitations: Confirms two TH18 X-Bow Supercharges exist; their exact values are not published in the note.

sources.title: X-Bow/Home Village
sources.limitations: Reports normal ground-only 14-tile and air-and-ground 11.5-tile modes at 0.128 seconds, 1,500 rounds, the two current Supercharge tables and free automatic reload after login. It has no immutable client build, projectile/collision trace, mid-battle reload contract or deterministic target/tick order.

sources.title: X-Bow
sources.limitations: Build-identified secondary table corroborates normal L1-L13 values, modes, 3x3 size and loaded/unloaded role; it does not provide Supercharge values, projectile/collision traces or deterministic targeting order.

sources.title: X-Bow
sources.limitations: Independently corroborates the current TH18 Supercharge 1/2 HP, DPS, cost and duration table. It has no published client build, ammunition lifecycle or combat trace.

sources.title: X-Bow payload
sources.limitations: Pins normal level data, modes and cadence but represents superseded Supercharge rows. The dated current secondary Supercharge table below replaces only those rows additively.

support.note: Core selects the serialised scenario mode before battle: normal is ground-only at 14 tiles, air_and_ground targets both at 11.5. Shared Core projectile state is exposed to Headless, Viewer and RL; flight, collision, target selection, ammunition depletion and exact tick order remain partial.

value.core_boundary: Fresh battle scenarios use the sourced armed combat stats but do not model village-persistent loaded/depleted state or reloading. No unsourced mid-battle reload or mode-transition proxy is enabled.

partial_mechanics_contract.note: Current secondary mechanic table; only mode selection and attack stats are materialised by the battle Core.

known_uncertainties: The current exact Supercharge values are secondary, though two independent current tables agree and the official June note confirms the two TH18 charges.
No consulted public source supplies a reproducible projectile trajectory, speed, collision width, target-loss, retarget or target-tie trace.
Ammunition capacity and out-of-battle reload are documented, but the serialized village depletion state, mid-battle reload and mode-transition lifecycle are not.
conclusion: X-Bow L1-L13 and TH18 Supercharge L1-L2 have a shared-Core normal/air-and-ground targeting baseline, current additive Supercharge values and snapshot/replay mode persistence; ammunition persistence and client projectile/ordering fidelity remain partial.
